what: On first open, the logo at the center of the background-color curtain stays for .5s and is then redrawn as accent-color pixel cells. It coarsens every .1s across 88, 44, 26, 16 and 12 columns (only cells where the logo covers over 50, 40, 30, 12 and 2% of the cell), then at 12 columns scales up 1.7 and 2.6 times until the whole curtain becomes accent color. After .24s it fires fx:done and the curtain clears over 1s ease. A first-visit greeting where the logo letters break into retro pixels and fill the screen

options.[data-fx-part=logo]: Logo SVG to redraw — size is set from the viewBox ratio, and currentColor is replaced with the pixel color when drawing
options.wait: First hold with only the logo visible (s), default .5
options.hold: Hold time (s) after covering with the accent color, default .24
options.size: At 768px and up, logo width (ratio of screen width), default .733 — on phones sizesm default .86
options.fit: Max logo height (ratio of screen height), default .662
options.once: Session storage key name — if given, runs only once the first time in that session (original doko-intro)
options.fx:done: Event the element emits when the curtain starts lifting (going up). While running, html[data-fx-loader=on] is attached, so the Hero intro may have to wait

note: The logo reads the consumer’s SVG as a raster as is (external font’s <text> is not called inside the drawing — use a path). With reduced motion, goes straight to fx:done with no curtain

from.where: The .dk-loader at the top of every page, from the original PageTransition: black curtain, purple #6130eb logo, 7 steps every 100ms after 500ms, purple fill 240ms, opacity 1s ease, first visit of the session only
